project.name: Newark V2G Fleet Value Simulator
project.comparison: Same 14-bus electric fleet with V2G versus the same fleet without V2G; bus purchase cost is shown as context but excluded from incremental V2G payback.
project.evidence_policy: Every value must be labeled measured, published, inferred, or scenario assumption. Values from comparison sites are not Newark-specific facts.

bus_count.note: UD fleet count only; do not imply the real buses are electric or V2G-capable.

battery_capacity_kwh_per_bus.source: SOURCES.md: WRI, Lessons from Electric School Bus V2G Programs (PGE example)
battery_capacity_kwh_per_bus.note: Comparison bus battery size; not UD bus specification.

starting_soc_fraction.note: Assume buses are charged before a modeled peak event.

minimum_departure_soc_fraction.note: Editable placeholder for the minimum charge needed before the next route; replace with route-energy analysis when available.

available_for_peak_event.note: All buses needed for the event are present and connected.

duration_hours.source: SOURCES.md: WRI, Lessons from Electric School Bus V2G Programs; three-hour PGE discharge test

events_per_year.note: For peak-event energy potential only; not multiplied into PJM regulation benchmark revenue.

dispatch_power_limit_kw_per_bus.source: SOURCES.md: WRI PGE example and Heliox 60 kW V2G charger page
dispatch_power_limit_kw_per_bus.note: Charger ceiling; usable event power is also limited by energy above the departure reserve.

site_export_limit_kw.note: 14 x 60 kW nameplate limit; no UD interconnection/export approval is implied.

round_trip_efficiency.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)
round_trip_efficiency.note: Pilot-measured comparator; not a UD bus measurement.

discharge_efficiency.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)
discharge_efficiency.note: Measured maximum at the tested operating point; use as an editable event-discharge proxy, not as a bus measurement.

regulation_average_power_throughput_rati.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)

regulation_dispatch_power_kw_per_vehicle.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)
regulation_dispatch_power_kw_per_vehicle.note: Pilot achieved 29 kW from a 33 kW-rated EV; used as a conservative per-bus market-equivalent, not a bus test result.

availability_hours_per_week.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)
availability_hours_per_week.note: Equivalent to the report's 40 hours/week unavailable case. Separate from the explicit all-buses-available peak-event assumption.

low.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)

central.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)

high.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)

retail_energy_cost_usd_per_kwh.source: SOURCES.md: Newark Electric Cost-of-Service and Rate Design Study, May 29, 2024
retail_energy_cost_usd_per_kwh.note: Published study lists the UD large-light-and-power contract energy charge at $0.0744/kWh through its FY2028 projection and says RSA is not applied. Verify actual contract/bill before treating as current tariff.

dpl_tou_comparator_net_savings_usd_per_3.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)
dpl_tou_comparator_net_savings_usd_per_3.note: Display as a separate Delmarva TOU comparison only; do not apply as the UD Newark tariff or add to PJM regulation value.

stack_market_values.note: Do not add PJM Regulation and TOU arbitrage in one scenario; the pilot calculated them separately.

annual_maintenance_cost_usd.note: Show as excluded, not zero real-world cost; editable when a quote or service contract exists.

ac_v2g_incremental_cost_usd_per_kw.source: SOURCES.md: UD/Exelon V2G fleet operations report (2026)
ac_v2g_incremental_cost_usd_per_kw.note: Mass-production incremental manufacturing estimate only; not a complete installed cost.

site_make_ready_installation_proxy_usd.note: One-depot placeholder: $545,460 package less $341,957 bus less $89,930 V2G charger. Not a transmission-only price and not a Newark engineering estimate.

dc_v2g_charger_reference_usd_per_unit.note: Alternative DC equipment scenario; do not add to AC incremental premium case.

electric_v2g_bus_reference_usd_per_unit.note: Full bus reference cost; excluded from incremental V2G economics because baseline includes same electric bus.

transmission_upgrade_equipment_cost_usd.evidence: unknown; no Newark study or quote
transmission_upgrade_equipment_cost_usd.note: Do not silently substitute make-ready cost for transmission cost. Include a user-entered value when a utility study or estimate is available.

citywide_summer_peak_mw_2024.source: SOURCES.md: DNREC Interim Project Report, Table 26
citywide_summer_peak_mw_2024.note: Citywide context only; never treated as the UD campus feeder peak or hosting capacity.

modeling_rules: Report the peak-event physical capability and annual market-value scenarios separately.
Do not claim verified Newark transmission-upgrade deferral or avoided cost.
Keep bus purchase cost separate from incremental V2G retrofit economics.
Do not double-count charging losses; regulation comparator formula subtracts loss-energy cost once.
Use low, central, and high scenarios and label historical revenue as a sensitivity, not a forecast.
Treat all uncertainty inputs as editable and surface each source/evidence label in the demo.
